pages.text: $(item)Estate timber$(): planks squared and banded with an iron nugget. Four to a batch. It goes into every post and every store.
$(item)Iron fittings$(): an ingot blacked over coal. Four to a batch. Corners, bands, hinges.
A $(item)ledger page$() is paper ruled in ink. Two to a batch. Every seal I set is set on one, so that it is on record.
$(item)Crimson wax$(): honeycomb and red dye. My family's colour. I had a right to it, on paper.
The $(item)crimson seal$(): wax on a ledger page, pressed with the family crest. A post raised under it is raised in their name. That amused me at the time.
